newsitem.title: UK: Headlam makes 32.9 mln stg offer for Gradus.
newsitem.headline: Headlam makes 32.9 mln stg offer for Gradus.

text.p: Furnishing and flooring company Headlam Group Plc said on Thursday it had agreed to make a 32.9 million stg offer to take over flooring and textiles firm Gradus Group Plc.
In a joint statement, the companies said the offer would be made on the basis of 39 new Headlam shares and 55.21 stg in cash for every 100 Gradus shares.
The offer values Gradus share at 164 pence,which is a premium of 38.5 pence per share or 30.7 percent over the closing mid-price of 125.5p on December 4.
Gradus shareholders would receive a second interim dividend for the year ending December 31, 1996 of four pence per share.

Explaining the benefits of the takeover, the statement said Gradus' carpet technology would enable Headlam to enter the project and specification market, while Gradus would gain from Headlam's established UK flooring distribution strengths.

Ian Kirkham, chief executive of Headlam said: "...our position as the UK's leading floorcoverings distributor is ideally compelemented by Gradus's position in the UK carpet market and its market leadership in floor accessories.
Gradus' group managing director John Symonds said the Headlam offer reflected good value for its shareholders and provided safeguards for all its employees.
